svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: contributions per month
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing: 51,559 contributions since 2017, through Nov 11, 2026. Columns show contributions per month on a log scale, where each gridline is ten times the one below. Yearly totals: 2017: 1; 2018: 17; 2019: 0; 2020: 8; 2021: 435; 2022: 280; 2023: 122; 2024: 505; 2025: 375; 2026: 49,816. Busiest month: Oct 2026, with 23,179 contributions. First contribution: Aug 2017. Counts follow GitHub's public contribution calendar and its published date labels. The dated snapshot includes today's partial activity.
svg.text: 97% of them in 2026 alone · contribution #1,000 landed in Jul 2024
Each gridline is 10× the one below. The faded bar is November so far.
